items.prompt: An invalid first record has ID T2; a later valid record also has ID T2. Under this lesson policy, what happens to the later one?

options.text: It is always duplicate because any appearance reserves an ID
options.why: Only an accepted record adds its ID to seen.

options.text: It is accepted if no earlier valid T2 was accepted
options.why: The invalid record does not reserve that identity.

options.text: It is silently dropped without an accepted/rejected entry
options.why: Every processed record belongs in one report branch.

options.text: The entire program must stop before reading it
options.why: This lesson deliberately uses partial acceptance.

items.explanation: The duplicate policy is explicit: only accepted IDs are reserved. Other applications may choose a different rule and must state it.
